entries.label: Toileting Baseline
entries.description: The person's usual toileting presentation, baseline routine, and typical level of support.

entries.label: Continence Support Level
entries.description: The expected level of continence-related support, cueing, or hands-on care.

entries.label: Usual Toileting Schedule
entries.description: The routine timing or pattern for toileting support.

entries.label: Toileting Prompt Level
entries.description: The usual prompt intensity needed for toileting participation.

entries.label: Toileting Assistance Level
entries.description: The expected overall assistance level during toileting support.

entries.label: Toileting Independence Level
entries.description: How independently the person usually completes toileting tasks.

entries.label: Clothing Management Support
entries.description: Support needed for clothing adjustment before or after toileting.

entries.label: Perineal Care Support
entries.description: Support needed for cleansing and hygiene after toileting.

entries.label: Brief Change Support
entries.description: Expected support for brief changes or incontinence care.

entries.label: Overnight Toileting Support
entries.description: Expected toileting support or continence care needed overnight.

entries.label: Transfer Support Level
entries.description: Required transfer support related to toileting movement and positioning.

entries.label: Mobility Status
entries.description: The person's current baseline mobility level relevant to toileting access and safety.

entries.label: Mobility Precautions
entries.description: Mobility-related precautions that apply during toileting support.

entries.label: Ambulation Support Level

entries.label: Positioning Support

entries.label: Two-Person Transfer Required

entries.label: Assistive Device Required

entries.label: Wheelchair Use

entries.label: Fall Risk Status

entries.label: Universal Precautions Required
entries.description: Whether universal precautions must be applied during toileting support.

entries.label: Toileting Safety Protocols

entries.label: Infection Control Precautions

entries.label: Injury Risk During Toileting

entries.label: Hemorrhoid or Rectal Concern History
